title: Investigation of prodromal features in metabolic syndrome based on transcriptome analysis
description: The goals of this study are to investigate the molecular mechanism of three groups, consist of normal, preMetS, MetS group. Overall design: A total of 100 subjects were classified as 33 normal, 42 Pre-Mets, and 25 MetS enrolled in this study.
